The Thunderstorm Thornblade has hard thorns and a ruthless heart. She shows no mercy to her challengers in defeating them and breaking off their thorns. Perhaps she was born this way, or maybe her nature changed after she lost her brother. Once an innocent flower, it was on that rainy night she blossomed the flower of mourning in her deepest sorrow, and since then, ruthless thorns began to grow on her. Given the choice, she would have preferred to stay with her brother, remaining as a couple of ordinary Budsquires they once were, or to have started sharpening her thorn as early as possible, so she could have defended her loved ones.

Long ago, the mountains of the Russet Highlands surged and boiled, and the earth trembled violently. The Aniimo clans that lived here faced catastrophe.
Then a Helmwhelp rushed to the summit and, enduring the searing agony that engulfed its body, swallowed a Flame Flower that bloomed brightly amid the raging inferno.
The mountains returned to peace, but the Helmwhelp’s body was scorched blood-red. From then on, it could breathe roaring flames, transforming into the legendary Infergon.
